summary: Autonomix Medical filed an 8-K reporting a warrant inducement offer letter with a holder of Series D-1 and D-2 warrants. The holder agreed to exercise existing warrants for 857,462 shares at $5.75 per share, generating ~$4.9 million gross proceeds. In exchange, the company issued new Series E-1 and E-2 warrants for up to 535,913 shares each, exercisable immediately at $6.25 per share with a five-year term. The new warrants have cashless exercise provisions and a 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership limitation. This is a capital-raising transaction that adds share overhang; watch for dilution from newly issued warrants and potential selling pressure.
